title: THE PIXEL WALL
why: Job 86d ship 1: with the pixel look on, a plain wall bakes once at one pixel per 2 world units (never again on a zoom or a resolution step) from the district wall and roof tone ramps: lit roof row, brick or panel courses, an ink foot row, cracks and stains by grit, bullet marks as ink pixels.
now: With the pixel look on (the default), walls are chunky stepped-colour pixel brick and panel. With the look off, nothing changes.

_px=pixOn();   // v33.57 (cw-pixwalls): the pixel look has no screen scale in its key, so a zoom or a resolution step never rebuilds it
